game_title: Type Cast Forge – Obsidian Quarry Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the forge smith ahead. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ember furnace by solving code steps involving forge_heat that move the forge smith forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ember furnace first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
